notes.title: [10/4 Patch Notes]
notes.content:
Today we released a patch that resolves the following issues.
We thank you for your feedback and understanding as we look into other reported issues. 
[list][*]Fixed button prompts for Argument Armament/Debate Scrum.
[*]Fixed bug that corrupted data if you saved before a class trial. (When loading corrupted data, screen is black except for text boxes.)
*If you were affected by this issue, please start the class trial over from Chapter Select.
[*]Made changes to certain vocal effects. [/list]
